summary: tools-manifest.json names the categories_list and categories_games tools by their effective apps.apple.com URLs (as resource_paths.go, the MCP handlers and the generated commands' pp:path already do); under a Printing Press harness the App Store client waits for send slots only within the harness's budget (verify 8 s, live matrix 22 s, from the start of the invocation) and refuses a later slot with nothing sent; a pacing refusal exits 7 like a throttle and stops fan-out loops; every command that reads Apple live declares pp:typed-exit-codes 0,7.
reason: Shipcheck run 1 (2026-10-24): verify's resource-path:export check failed critically because the generator writes the bare endpoint path (/us/iphone/charts/36) into tools-manifest.json but the resource's base_url-qualified URL into resource_paths.go, and compares them literally. Verify's mock mode cannot reach the hand-built client (it ignores APP_STORE_BASE_URL), so page commands read Apple live inside verify's 15 s budget; with pages paced 20 s apart across runs (one shared scoped home per verify run) the later page commands were killed mid-wait or met Apple's 429, and none declared exit 7 as a typed outcome. The press's own precedent for governed CLIs is pp:typed-exit-codes 0,7 (sbp).
validated_outcome: go build, go vet and go test -count=1 ./... green; new tests: TestGovernorRefusesASlotPastWaitUntil (a slot past WaitUntil is refused in under 500 ms with no request sent and no slot reserved; a free slot inside it is sent), TestPacingRefusalExits7 (exit 7, 'nothing was sent' plus a retry hint, isRateLimited true so fan-out loops stop) and TestHarnessWaitUntilFitsEachHarnessBudget (no cap outside a harness; verify start+8 s; live matrix start+22 s). Zero live requests were made for these fixes.
